paper_title: PyramidInfer Pyramid KV Cache Compression for High-throughput LLM   Inference
caption: The evaluation of inference methods using an A100 80GB GPU on LLaMA 2-13B and 70B. Length: prefill length + generation length. Bsz: batch size. KV mem.: GPU memory usage (GB) of the KV cache. Thr.: throughput (token/s) : S_r ratio ablation study.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the performance of different inference methods under varying recent sequence ratios (from 20% to 100%) on an A100 80GB GPU for LLaMA 2-13B and 70B models, focusing on perplexity and GPU memory usage. The x-axis represents the "Recent Sequence Ratio (%)" on a linear scale ranging from 20 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 20. The left y-axis, labeled "Perplexity," ranges from 4.2 to 4.7 on a linear scale, while the right y-axis, labeled "GPU Mem. Ratio (%)," ranges from 40 to 100 on a linear scale. Four lines are plotted: an orange solid line with circular markers labeled "Perplexity" that starts at approximately 4.6 at 20% ratio, decreases to around 4.3 at 80%, then rises slightly to about 4.4 at 100%; a blue solid line with circular markers labeled "GPU Mem. Ratio" that remains flat at approximately 42% from 20% to 80% ratio, then sharply increases to 100% at 100% ratio; a red dashed line labeled "Full Cache PPL" that is constant at 4.35 across all ratios; and a blue dashed line labeled "Full Cache GPU Mem." that is constant at 100% across all ratios. The plot demonstrates how perplexity and GPU memory ratio change with increasing recent sequence ratio, with the blue solid line indicating a significant memory usage spike at higher ratios.
